dialogue.name: Stephanie
dialogue.text: Holy... shit. What the fuck are you... BETTER YET, WHO EVEN ARE YOU? HOW are you even alive...? I literally just shot you. DEAD. In the head.

dialogue.name: Stephanie
dialogue.text: You could've just said I missed, jackass. Use your fucking words.

dialogue.name: Stephanie
dialogue.text: But this time... I really won't miss.

dialogue.name: Stephanie
dialogue.text: AHAHAHA! Did you see how he fucking ragdolled??! HAHAHA!!

dialogue.name: Stephanie
dialogue.text: Stupid little brat thinks he's such hot shit. You are not the main character...

dialogue.name: Stephanie
dialogue.text: No.. there's actually no way...you're not normal are you? That blast should've been fatal. W-what do you even want with me?

dialogue.name: Stephanie
dialogue.text: Ohhh right, lemme guess. You wanna be the big hero of this wholeee story, huh? Listen buddy, let me tell you're not cool as you think you are, you're not gonna get anything outta of this.

dialogue.name: Stephanie
dialogue.text: It's weird, I can actually understand exactly what you're saying when you don't speak. That's like... really weird. Stop that.

dialogue.name: Stephanie
dialogue.text: But don't worry... If you want to play, we can play. I PROMISE... you won't be remembered after this. BRING IT ON, BITCH!
